title: Cosmic Selfie Vortex
description: A surreal scene shows a woman in a patterned bikini and crown sitting cross-legged on a bed taking a selfie with her phone. To her left is a large oval mirror reflecting her image, while to the right she appears upside down underwater surrounded by floating smartphones and spiral patterns. Above them a massive glowing spiral galaxy vortex dominates the cosmic sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a woman wearing a crown and patterned bikini sitting cross-legged on a bed with pink sheets, holding a smartphone for a selfie. A large oval watery mirror beside her reflects the same woman taking a selfie. To the right, the same woman is submerged upside down underwater with long hair floating, surrounded by sinking smartphones and spiral patterns. A massive luminous spiral galaxy vortex swirls in the starry cosmic sky above with colorful nebulae and floating flowers, ethereal dreamlike atmosphere.
